sample_unit: instrument_id + fact_id unique retained workpaper object, not each metric or repeated view
supplemental_selection: Exclude independently mapped core-support fact IDs. If <=20 objects remain, review all. Otherwise take the lowest SHA256(seed|instrument_id|fact_id) in each present group (metrics, qualitative, optional company_features/supply_chain), then fill by the same stable order to 20. Review all additional discovered doubts separately and deduplicate totals.
actual_projection_types: WorkpaperFact with/without metric structure and optional feature/supply-chain elements. Do not fabricate typed Activity/Measurement counts not written by this path.
source_review: Read source-supported business meaning, subject/period, financial header/unit/column, qualifications and omissions. Coordinate/hash checks support source identity but do not replace semantic judgment.
counting: Record each actually reviewed unique object verdict and core-condition verdict. Preserve original wrong candidates and first outcome. Independent withholding affects the derived research preview, never overwrites original query/raw receipts. Missing or unreviewed source does not imply correct/not_disclosed.
limitations: No automatic S1/production release. Report formal negative-suite coverage separately from observed source/output risk challenges; do not count absent assertions or unchecked failures as a passed negative. Unknown/incomplete audit scopes remain explicit.
